So here we have "盗窃;诈骗". However note that the first part also includes using counterfeit money to defraud? The first part is theft of cash by swapping with counterfeit money. That's theft (盗窃). The second part is fraud (诈骗). So answer: [罪名]盗窃;诈骗<eoa>.
